tiers.label: Tier A (baseline linear/FE-equivalent)
tiers.interpretationBoundary: Primary refit OOS evidence tier; interpretation remains support-conditioned under thin effective support.

tiers.label: Tier B (parsimonious nonlinear core)
tiers.interpretationBoundary: Primary refit OOS evidence tier; interpretation remains support-conditioned under thin effective support.

tiers.label: Tier C (full nonlinear sensitivity)
tiers.interpretationBoundary: Exploratory sensitivity tier; not used for headline inference under thin effective support.

decisionContext.note: Tier A/B are primary inferential candidates; Tier C remains exploratory unless stronger support and independent stability/OOS checks are adequate.

effectiveSupport.supportDensityNote: All tiered interpretations are conditioned on thin effective support and should not be read as unrestricted population generalization.

interpretationGuardrails.headlinePolicy: Headline inferential claims are restricted to Tier A/B evidence families; Tier C is retained for exploratory sensitivity only.
